messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Korean-language 2D roguelike deck game with simple, satisfying synergies between defense, effects, and traits.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Created a browser-based deckbuilding game called “잿빛 서약” with four battles, card rewards, persistent traits, and an introductory help modal.
- Used CSS-built visuals and Korean card/combat text; no external game engine.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created game landing page, combat UI, responsive styling, card/effect/trait data, rewards, and win/defeat screens.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest edits.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Installed Chromium and opened the app with Playwright; initial screenshot showed a JavaScript error because `game.js` had been overwritten/truncated during writes.

### Active
- Finish and validate `game.js`. Latest writes replaced it with only the beginning and partial functions; it currently lacks `renderEnding`, `showHelp`, help button binding, and `makeRun()` invocation.
- Verify gameplay, fix discovered bugs, and capture/read a latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser check is currently blocked by incomplete `game.js`; initial console error was `ReferenceError: $ is not defined` because only trailing functions had initially been written. Subsequent writes restored the opening definitions, but the file is incomplete.

## Next Move
1. Continue appending `game.js` with missing remainder: `renderEnding`, `showHelp`, `$('#help-btn').onclick=showHelp`, and `makeRun()`.
2. Run `node --check game.js`; open/reload `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright and check console.
3. Exercise start, card plays, end turn, rewards, and restart; fix any issues.
4. Save a small latest JPEG screenshot and inspect it; summarize assumptions and validation in final.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay implementation; currently incomplete due to latest replacement writes.
- `index.html`: app shell, labels, and stylesheet/script links.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and game visuals.

## Important Context
- `screenshots/home.jpg` exists but reflects the broken initial landing attempt; do not rely on it as final verification.
- Browser console initially showed `ReferenceError: $ is not defined`; `game.js` was rewritten afterward and needs a fresh check.
- Working tree changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Deliver a complete, playable Korean-language 2D roguelike deck game with simple synergies between defense, effects, and traits.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based deckbuilder, “잿빛 서약,” with four battles, card rewards, persistent traits, Korean combat text, and a help modal.
- Used CSS-built visuals without an external game engine.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the landing page, combat UI, responsive styles, card/effect/trait data, rewards, and endings.
- Rebuilt `game.js` after discovering it had been truncated; added game logic, rendering, rewards, ending, and help modal.

### Active
- Validate the repaired game and exercise combat, rewards, and restart behavior.

### Blocked
- Browser capture previously reported `$ is not defined` because a write had replaced `game.js` with only its ending/help functions. The opening definitions and game logic were restored afterward, but validation has not yet been rerun.

1. Run `node --check game.js` and inspect the complete file to confirm all expected definitions are present.
2. Reload `http://localhost:3002` with strict browser capture; verify there are no page errors.
3. Exercise start, card plays, end turn, rewards, and restart; fix any issues.
4. Save and inspect a current screenshot, then summarize assumptions and validation.

- `game.js`: gameplay implementation; recently reconstructed and pending validation.
- `index.html`: app shell and script/style links.
- `style.css`: responsive game visuals.
- `screenshots/`: contains an outdated `home.jpg` from the broken initial build and a `check/` capture attempt.
